query.name: us.ma.k12.lawrence.classdojo.enrollments
query.sql:
with yearquery as (select id, abbreviation from terms where portion = 1 AND terms.lastday > sysdate AND sysdate > terms.firstday-30 AND schoolid=0 )
select 'ST'||sectionteacher.id||'-T'||schoolstaff.users_dcid as sourcedId, 'T'||schoolstaff.users_dcid as userSourcedId, sectionteacher.sectionid as classSourcedId, sections.schoolid as schoolSourcedId, case roledef.name when 'Lead Teacher' then 'true' when 'Co-teacher' then null when 'DESE Co-teacher' then null when 'ESL/SPED Teacher' then null when 'Teacher''s Aide' then null when 'Principal' then null when 'School Administrator' then null else null end as primary, case roledef.name when 'Lead Teacher' then 'teacher' when 'Co-teacher' then 'teacher' when 'DESE Co-teacher' then 'teacher' when 'ESL/SPED Teacher' then 'teacher' when 'Teacher''s Aide' then 'teacher' when 'Principal' then 'administrator' when 'School Administrator' then 'administrator' else 'teacher' end as role
from sectionteacher join sections on sectionteacher.sectionid = sections.id join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.id = sectionteacher.teacherid and schoolstaff.SchoolID = sections.schoolid join schools on schoolstaff.SchoolID = schools.School_Number join users on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid join roledef on sectionteacher.roleid = roledef.id and (sysdate between sectionteacher.start_date-21 and sectionteacher.end_date+21) left join yearquery on 1=1 join (SELECT sectionid, COUNT(sectionid) as NO_OF_STUDENTS from cc GROUP BY sectionid ) q ON sections.id = q.sectionid and sectionteacher.sectionid in ( select sections.id from sections left join yearquery on 1=1 where sections.termid between yearquery.id and yearquery.id+99 ) and (users.teacherloginid is not null or users.loginid is not null) where sections.termid between yearquery.id and yearquery.id+99 and schoolstaff.status = 1 and schoolstaff.staffstatus = 1 and users.PTAccess = 1
union all
select 'S'||cc.dcid as sourcedId, 'S'||students.dcid as userSourcedId, cc.sectionid as classSourcedId, cc.schoolid as schoolSourcedId, null as primary, 'student' as role from cc join students on cc.studentid = students.id join schools on cc.schoolid = schools.school_number left join yearquery on 1=1 join sections on cc.sectionid = sections.id join teachers t on sections.teacher=t.id and t.ptaccess = 1 and t.status = 1 and t.StaffStatus = 1 where students.enroll_status in (0,-1) and (cc.termid between yearquery.id and yearquery.id+99) and cc.dateleft > cc.dateenrolled and (sysdate between cc.dateenrolled-21 and cc.dateleft+21)
